property.name: SupportsMagnifyAnisotropic
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage anisotropic filtering for magnifying textures.
property.remarks: Anisotropic filters compensate for distortion caused by the difference in angle between the texture polygon and the plane of the screen. The anisotropic magnification filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Anisotropic enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMagnifyGaussianQuad
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports per-stage Gaussian quad filtering for magnifying textures.
property.remarks: The Gaussian quad filter is represented by the TextureFilter.GaussianQuad enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMagnifyLinear
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage bilinear interpolation filtering for magnifying textures.
property.remarks: The bilinear interpolation mipmapping filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Linear enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMagnifyPoint
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage point-sample filtering for magnifying textures.
property.remarks: The point-sample magnification filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Point enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMagnifyPyramidalQuad
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage pyramidal sample filtering for magnifying textures.
property.remarks: The pyramidal sample filter is represented by the TextureFilter.PyramidalQuad enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMinifyAnisotropic
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage anisotropic filtering for minifying textures.
property.remarks: The anisotropic minification filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Anisotropic enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMinifyGaussianQuad
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports per-stage Gaussian quad filtering for minifying textures.
property.remarks: The Gaussian quad filter is represented by the TextureFilter.GaussianQuad enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMinifyLinear
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage bilinear interpolation filtering for minifying textures.
property.remarks: The linear minification filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Linear enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMinifyPoint
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates whether the device supports per-stage point-sample filtering for minifying textures.
property.remarks: The point-sample minification filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Point enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMinifyPyramidalQuad
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage pyramidal sample filtering for minifying textures.
property.remarks: The pyramidal sample filter is represented by the TextureFilter.PyramidalQuad enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMipMapLinear
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage trilinear interpolation filtering for mipmaps.
property.remarks: The bilinear interpolation mipmapping filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Linear enumerated value.

property.name: SupportsMipMapPoint
property.summary: Gets a value that indicates that the device supports per-stage point-sample filtering for mipmaps.
property.remarks: The point-sample mipmapping filter is represented by the TextureFilter.Point enumerated value.
